high.title: A clearer inner room
high.summary: Your answers suggest that awareness is near the surface today. You may already be noticing what you feel, what you need, and where your attention is being pulled.
high.attention: Protect this clarity from becoming pressure. Awareness is most useful when it stays compassionate, not when it turns into another demand to understand everything at once.
high.exploration: Keep asking small, honest questions before the day becomes too loud.
high.mirrorMoment: You do not need to rush past what you are finally able to notice.

medium.title: A quiet beginning of noticing
medium.summary: Awareness appears as an emerging theme. Some parts of your experience may feel visible, while other parts still need time before they can be named.
medium.attention: The invitation is not to force an answer, but to create enough quiet that an answer can arrive naturally.
medium.exploration: Notice what repeats in your thoughts when nothing is asking for your performance.
medium.mirrorMoment: Something in you is already paying attention.

low.title: A life moving quickly
low.summary: Your reflection suggests that awareness may be harder to access right now. This can happen when life has required movement, competence, or endurance for too long.
low.attention: Begin with the body and the moment you are in. You do not have to explain your whole life to return to yourself.
low.exploration: Try naming one sensation, one need, or one small truth without needing it to be complete.
low.mirrorMoment: Even a faint signal is still a signal.

high.title: Feelings asking to be honored
high.summary: Emotion is vivid in your reflection. There may be feelings you have carried privately, understood late, or protected because they matter.
high.attention: Strong emotion does not mean you are too much. It may mean something important has been asking for language.
high.exploration: Ask what each feeling is trying to protect, not only what it is trying to express.
high.mirrorMoment: What you feel deserves room before it becomes a conclusion.

medium.title: An emotional current beneath the surface
medium.summary: Your answers point to emotion as present but measured. You may sense what is there without fully entering it yet.
medium.attention: Let emotion arrive in portions. Gentle contact can be more sustainable than intensity.
medium.exploration: Notice which feelings become clearer only after the moment has passed.
medium.mirrorMoment: You are allowed to understand yourself slowly.

low.title: A softer doorway to feeling
low.summary: Emotion may be quieter in this reflection. That quiet can be numbness, steadiness, protection, or simply the shape of today.
low.attention: Do not treat emotional quiet as absence. Sometimes the first honest step is admitting that you do not know what you feel yet.
low.exploration: Begin with what feels easy, tense, heavy, or light.
low.mirrorMoment: Not knowing is still a truthful place to begin.

high.title: Patterns becoming visible
high.summary: Your reflection suggests you are noticing familiar reactions, repeated feelings, or old material showing up in present moments.
high.attention: Seeing a pattern is not the same as being trapped by it. Recognition can become a doorway rather than a verdict.
high.exploration: Ask where this response first learned to keep you safe.
high.mirrorMoment: The pattern is information, not identity.

medium.title: A thread you are beginning to follow
medium.summary: Patterns are present, though not overwhelming. You may be starting to connect experiences that once felt separate.
medium.attention: Stay curious instead of corrective. The goal is to understand the rhythm before trying to change it.
medium.exploration: Notice when a current moment feels older than it is.
medium.mirrorMoment: Curiosity can loosen what criticism keeps tight.

low.title: Less repetition in focus today
low.summary: Patterns were not the loudest theme in this reflection. Today may be more about the present moment than the origins of your responses.
low.attention: If nothing obvious repeats, let that be useful information too. Reflection does not need to excavate every day.
low.exploration: Watch gently for moments that feel familiar without forcing a story around them.
low.mirrorMoment: Some days ask for presence, not analysis.

high.title: A stronger sense of choosing
high.summary: Agency is prominent in your answers. There may be a growing trust in your capacity to move, decide, and listen for your own voice.
high.attention: Choice does not require total certainty. Often it asks for enough honesty to take the next faithful step.
high.exploration: Identify one decision that would feel like self-respect, even if it stays small.
high.mirrorMoment: You can move before every doubt has disappeared.

medium.title: Choice at the edge of readiness
medium.summary: Your reflection suggests agency is available, but mixed with hesitation, responsibility, or the voices of others.
medium.attention: The work may be separating caution from fear, and care for others from abandonment of yourself.
medium.exploration: Ask which option makes you feel more honest, not only more approved.
medium.mirrorMoment: Your voice can be quiet and still be yours.

low.title: A need to reclaim your own voice
low.summary: Agency may feel less accessible right now. Decisions might feel delayed, crowded, or shaped by expectations around you.
low.attention: Start with one small choice that belongs fully to you. Reclaiming agency often begins beneath the dramatic level.
low.exploration: Notice where you say yes before checking whether you mean it.
low.mirrorMoment: A small honest choice can reopen a larger path.

high.title: A horizon beginning to form
high.summary: Direction is strong in your reflection. You may not have every answer, but there is a sense of becoming, growth, or a life that wants to align more closely with you.
high.attention: Let direction stay alive rather than fixed. A true horizon guides you without demanding that you arrive immediately.
high.exploration: Ask what kind of future feels more like breathing than performing.
high.mirrorMoment: You are allowed to grow toward a shape you cannot fully see yet.

medium.title: A future softly asking for attention
medium.summary: Direction is present as a question. You may sense movement without knowing exactly what it will become.
medium.attention: Uncertainty does not mean you are lost. It may mean the next version of your life is still gathering language.
medium.exploration: Notice what gives you energy before you try to turn it into a plan.
medium.mirrorMoment: Not all direction begins as certainty.

low.title: A pause before the next shape
low.summary: Direction may feel quiet or unclear today. This can be a meaningful pause rather than a problem to solve quickly.
low.attention: If the future feels distant, return to the next true thing. Direction can begin with one aligned moment.
low.exploration: Ask what you no longer want to abandon in yourself.
low.mirrorMoment: The path can be unclear while the next step is still real.

closingQuestions.awareness: What small truth about yourself can you make room for today?
closingQuestions.emotion: What feeling might soften if it were allowed to be heard?
closingQuestions.patterns: What familiar response are you ready to meet with curiosity?
closingQuestions.agency: What choice would feel quietly loyal to yourself?
closingQuestions.direction: What future version of you is asking for one small gesture now?
